text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn)—
The one standing in Gentildonna's way this time was...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Jordan-san and I will be your opponents.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Gah?!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: You all are...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no!
I didn't say anything!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait,
Fla-san!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"As senior-and-junior buds, maybe we could
teach 'em something~?" is what you said before.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I didn't sa—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the cheek...!
I'm your senpai on the racetrack, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Should we show 'em the ropes,
as a senior duo?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—...telling me.
She's totally telling me...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
B-But... it's seriously freakin' scary!
The younger generation makes no sense at all!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "However, we have our pride."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: To the long journey that has led the scene up to this point.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...W-Well, sure...
That's true, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Gentildonna-san,
allow me to say once again... it is an honor to work with you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I pay my utmost respects
to what you have achieved.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, as a senior in the Senior year...
I will claim victory through the strength I have properly built up.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Your true strength lies in—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: In that case.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I would also like to express my respect
for both of your dedication to racing.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It is truly an honor... to have my name added
to your illustrious career.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
“As the winner.
Please, face me in a match.”
